failureReason: The model attempted to implement the ContactForm component but failed in different ways across runs. In runs 1-2, it tried to use a non-existent "replace" tool and hallucinated success without actually modifying any files. In run 3, it successfully wrote code using file_write but the implementation didn't match test requirements: it used Zod validation instead of JavaScript validation with !name || !email || !message pattern, and didn't add "Contact Us" heading to page.tsx as expected by tests.
